title: PDE-constrained optimization for virtual sensing in structural dynamics: Full-field displacement and force recovery from sparse sensors
summary: Virtual sensing -- recovering full-field structural response from sparse sensor measurements -- is a fundamental challenge in structural health monitoring (SHM). Fracture assessment, fatigue evaluation and remaining useful life (RUL) prognosis all take the applied load as their input, and that load frequently acts on surfaces that cannot be instrumented. An improved load estimate is therefore of direct practical value for SHM and for prognostics and health management (PHM).
